threads.title: Data Center capacity target
threads.note: Last mentioned Feb 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Shashwat Sharma
history.quote: Our plan is to reach 1 gigawatt capacity in the next three to four years and grow significantly ahead of the market.

threads.title: FY27 capex ballpark
threads.note: Last mentioned May 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Gopal Vittal
history.quote: The net result of all of that, if you look at the capex, while we do not give guidance typically, our sense is that we will be in femoral of this year, give or take a little bit.

history.speaker: Gopal Vittal
history.quote: Given this growth trajectory and the large addressable opportunity, Airtel Money is now preparing for a London listing in the second half of 2026.

history.speaker: Shashwat Sharma
history.quote: So I think it is a combination. We see reasonable headroom in front of us to continue this momentum in the mid-term.

synthesis.headline: Management repeatedly drops quantitative guidance targets while annual revenue and operating margin steadily expand.

points.text: Management dropped its data center capacity target after a single mention, showing a lack of consistent follow-through on long-term infrastructure goals.
The FY27 capex ballpark was similarly dropped after May 2026, leaving investors without forward-looking capital expenditure guidance.
Despite unverified qualitative promises regarding Airtel Money and mobile ARPU, actual annual revenue grew to 210973.0 crore by Mar 2026.
Operating margin improved to 55.2% in Mar 2026 alongside strong cash from operations reaching 122230.0 crore.

bull.text: Annual revenue rose consistently from 100616.0 crore in Mar 2021 to 210973.0 crore in Mar 2026.
Cash from operations scaled significantly to reach 122230.0 crore by Mar 2026, supporting financial stability.

bear.text: Key strategic targets like the data center capacity and FY27 capex were dropped from subsequent calls.
Borrowings remained high at 199432.0 crore as of Sep 2026 against equity of 158047.0 crore.

business.what: Bharti Airtel provides telecommunications services, digital portfolio solutions, home broadband, enterprise connectivity, financial services, and data center infrastructure across India and Africa.
business.quote: Performance across India and Africa was strong.
